Should words be deduplicated, or should all occurrences be saved as they appear in the text?
Is the CSV file expected to have a newline after the last data row, or is any valid CSV format acceptable?

Does 'excluding any words that are composed of characters' mean excluding words where all characters after $ are punctuation, or excluding words where any character after $ is punctuation?
Should the CSV file use a specific delimiter (like comma) or is any default csv.writer delimiter acceptable?
